failure_modes.failure_mode: Command sent to wrong zone controller
failure_modes.cause: Zone field corrupted in transit or mis-set by caller
failure_modes.detection: None — the retired Zone/Controller model this row described no longer exists
failure_modes.mitigation: None — REQ-CTRL-003 (this row's original mitigation) was purged along with the retired model; see HARA.md H-001 (endpoint misaddressing) and SG-001 (REQ-EPLK-*, addressing::EndpointTable) for the current endpoint-addressed model's equivalent hazard and mitigation
failure_modes.note: This row presented the retired Zone/Controller model (RELAY spec §15.5) as a live failure mode with a mitigation pointing at REQ-CTRL-003, a requirement that was itself purged when that model was removed (rust-RCP-FS-02/general Zone retirement) — a dangling reference to a hazard that could not recur through the current, endpoint-addressed dispatch path. Retained here for audit-trail continuity rather than deleted outright, per this crate's 'never renumber or reuse' FM-ID discipline (see FM-009's own identical precedent)

failure_modes.effect: Incorrect actuation data applied to ECU
failure_modes.cause: Bit error(s) inside the CRC-32 coverage region of a safe-point AVTPDU/ACF frame
failure_modes.detection: check_rx_enforce_e2e compares the TC18 safe-point crc32_tc18 against the wire-carried expected_crc and constructs RcpError::CrcError on mismatch (REQ-CRC-011, REQ-E2EENF-002)
failure_modes.mitigation: REQ-CRC-004 CRC-32 coverage buffer assembly + REQ-CRC-003 single-bit-flip sensitivity
failure_modes.note: Milestone 9's e2e REPLACE cutover (ROADMAP.md) removed the prior CRC-16/CCITT-FALSE mechanism this failure mode described (crate::e2e::wrap/unwrap); this row now describes the surviving CRC-32 safe-point mechanism, per the same retargeting discipline used for FM-005/watchdog

failure_modes.cause: No live anti-replay mechanism is wired into a request-acceptance path
failure_modes.detection: None currently live; evaluate_rx_enforce_seq (REQ-SEQENF-003) exists as caller-invocable, standalone plumbing but is not called from any decoder or dispatch loop
failure_modes.mitigation: REQ-SEQENF-003 monotonic rx_enforce_seq check, once wired into a live request path; until then, running RCP over the mutually authenticated TLS bridge is the only real-world mitigation against a network-capable attacker
failure_modes.note: Milestone 9's e2e REPLACE cutover (ROADMAP.md) deleted the legacy ReplayGuard sliding-window guard this failure mode originally described, with no live replacement built yet; residual_risk is raised from its prior 'low' rating to reflect that honestly rather than retargeting onto a not-yet-wired mechanism at the same confidence level

failure_modes.failure_mode: CRITICAL command starved behind NORMAL backlog
failure_modes.effect: Safety-critical command delayed in emergency scenario
failure_modes.detection: None currently live; execution_priority_tier/select_next_pending_request (REQ-PRIO-004) exist as caller-invocable, standalone plumbing but are not called from any decoder or dispatch loop
failure_modes.mitigation: REQ-PRIO-004 execution-priority-tier ordering (cancellation > triggered > timed > compound > compound-wait > chained > standard), once wired into a live request path
failure_modes.note: Milestone 9's DEPRECATE-disposition removal (ROADMAP.md Satellite Package Disposition) deleted prioqueue::PrioController outright, the separate CRITICAL/HIGH/NORMAL queue this failure mode originally described; request::execution_priority_tier/select_next_pending_request (REQ-PRIO-004, built ahead of schedule in Milestone 5) is the closest surviving analog, but is not yet wired into any dispatch loop, so residual_risk is raised from its prior 'low' rating to reflect that honestly, mirroring FM-003's own treatment of the e2e REPLACE cutover

failure_modes.effect: ECU failure goes undetected; vehicle subsystem silently fails
failure_modes.cause: A stream's rx_wd_timeout_interval elapses with no request resetting its liveness, but rx_wd_enable is not evaluated or the expiry check is skipped
failure_modes.detection: evaluate_stream_watchdog resets liveness on every request received (StreamWatchdogState::reset_on_request) and reports ExpiredNoSafestate/ExpiredSafestate once rx_wd_timeout_interval elapses without one
failure_modes.mitigation: REQ-WDG-002 per-request liveness reset + REQ-WDG-004/REQ-WDG-005 expiry-and-safestate gating

failure_modes.failure_mode: A request stream carrying safety-relevant requests is left on rx_secure_channel_index 0 (no security / MACsec uncontrolled port), or the deployment does not enforce MACsec on the link at all
failure_modes.effect: Man-in-the-middle can inject or observe commands
failure_modes.cause: Deployment omits the link-layer MACsec control TC18 delegates to it, or misconfigures the per-stream secure-channel index
failure_modes.detection: RequestStreamConfigEntry::rx_secure_channel_index is wire-readable/writable (REQ-RMAP-015), so an integrator or configuring client can verify which MACsec channel each stream is bound to; enforcement itself is outside this library
failure_modes.mitigation: Deployment-level control: MACsec enforced by the deployment (c-RCP parity: c-RCP ROADMAP.md:104 tls.h/tls.c DEPRECATE disposition, include/rcp/authz.h:45, HARA.md SG-007, tara.json TS-004). rust-RCP's former tlstransport TLS bridge (REQ-TLS-002, now retired) was removed by issue #211; REQ-RMAP-015 exposes the secure-channel selector

failure_modes.failure_mode: Exhausted bucket does not return Busy
failure_modes.effect: DoS allows unlimited commands to flood a controller
failure_modes.cause: Token bucket logic error; tokens underflow or not checked
failure_modes.mitigation: REQ-RL-006 Busy sentinel; the old exempt_critical carve-out (REQ-RL-007) was retired by Milestone 9's ADAPT retarget since Endpoint requests carry no Priority — see .fusa-iec62443.json T-004 for how DoS-vs-critical-priority mitigation is handled now

failure_modes.failure_mode: Loaned buffer not returned to pool on drop
failure_modes.cause: Loan::drop() not implemented or release callback not called
failure_modes.detection: impl Drop for Loan calls release() callback
failure_modes.mitigation: REQ-LOAN-004 Drop impl + return_loan() both call release

failure_modes.failure_mode: Group command dispatched to members with wrong zone field
failure_modes.effect: Member controllers reject command with ZoneMismatch
failure_modes.cause: cmd.zone not rewritten to member zone before dispatch
failure_modes.detection: None — the function no longer exists
failure_modes.mitigation: None — no analog exists in the endpoint-addressed model
failure_modes.note: Milestone 9's DEPRECATE-disposition removal (ROADMAP.md Satellite Package Disposition) deleted zonegroup::ZoneGroup outright, per the disposition table's own reason: multi-endpoint fan-out has no direct equivalent once Zone disappears, and is not modeled anywhere in the new endpoint-addressed core. This failure mode cannot presently occur, since no group-broadcast capability exists for cmd.zone to be mis-rewritten within; retained here for audit-trail continuity rather than deleted outright, per this crate's 'never renumber or reuse' FM-ID discipline

failure_modes.mitigation: REQ-WIRE-003 header validation + 30s fuzz smoke in CI
